title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 165 § 94G, as amended by St. 198l, c. 357 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 896, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of March thru May 1995. As an alternative to the quarterly adjustment, the Co. will propose a sem-annual adjustment to the fuel charge covering meter readings during the six billing months of March thru August 1995. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Co. for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to qualifying facilities for purchase power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 586 during the same time periods.
